purpose: Deterministically classify 4H/1D/1W completed-candle market structure for TREND scoring without GPT judgement or lookahead.

pivot_rule.swing_high: bar.high must be strictly greater than every high in left and right confirmation windows
pivot_rule.swing_low: bar.low must be strictly lower than every low in left and right confirmation windows
pivot_rule.confirmation: a pivot is usable only after pivot_right later candles have completed
pivot_rule.minimum_swings: at least two confirmed swing highs and two confirmed swing lows are required
pivot_rule.tie_policy: equal highs/lows do not form a confirmed pivot

facts.HH: latest confirmed swing high > previous confirmed swing high
facts.LH: latest confirmed swing high < previous confirmed swing high
facts.HL: latest confirmed swing low > previous confirmed swing low
facts.LL: latest confirmed swing low < previous confirmed swing low
facts.BOS_UP: latest completed close > latest confirmed swing high
facts.BOS_DOWN: latest completed close < latest confirmed swing low
facts.RECLAIM: previous completed close <= latest confirmed swing high and latest completed close > it
facts.BREAKDOWN: previous completed close >= latest confirmed swing low and latest completed close < it

classifier.LONG: BOS_UP, or HH+HL while BOS_DOWN is false
classifier.SHORT: BOS_DOWN, or LH+LL while BOS_UP is false
classifier.break_priority: BOS direction overrides a conflicting prior HH/HL or LH/LL sequence but is not STRONG unless the sequence agrees

availability.CURRENT: all source bars are completed, enough history exists, and two confirmed highs/lows exist
availability.N_A_INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: not enough completed bars or confirmed swings

shadow_target.note: 68% remains below the 70% production confirmation threshold; R2.2 cannot promote by itself.
